trait.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
entries: As a bonus action after moving at least 10 mètres on the ground, the zaratan can send a shock wave through the ground in a 120-foot-radius circle centered on itself. That area becomes {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for 1 minute. Each creature on the ground that is {@status concentration||concentrating} doit réussir on a {@dd 25}jet de sauvegarde Constitution or la créature's {@status concentration} is broken.

The shock wave deals 100 thunderdgts to all structures in contact with the ground in the area. If une créature is near a structure that collapses, la créature might be buried; une créature within half the distance of the structure's height doit faire a {@dd 25}Dextérité saving throw. On a failed save, la créature takes 17 ({@dégât 5d6}) bludgeoningdgts, is knocked {@condition à terre}, and is trapped in the rubble. A trapped creature is {@condition entravé}, requiring a successful {@dd 20}Force ({@skill Athlétisme}) check as an action to escape. Another creature within 5 mètres of the buried creature can use its action to clear rubble and grant advantage on the check. If three creatures use their actions in this way, the check is an automatic success. On a successful save, la créature takes half as muchdgts and doesn't fall {@condition à terre} or become trapped.

entries: Zuggtmoy releases spores that burst out in a cloud that fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on her, and it lingers for 1 minute. Any flesh-and-blood creature in the cloud lorsque it appears, or that enters it later, doit faire a {@dd 19}jet de sauvegarde Constitution. On a successful save, la créature can't be infected by these spores for 24 heures. On a failed save, la créature is infected with a disease called the spores of Zuggtmoy and also gains a random form of madness (determined by rolling on the Madness of Zuggtmoy table) that lasts until la créature is cured of the disease or dies. While infected in this way, la créature can't be reinfected, and it must repeat the saving throw at the end of every 24 heures, ending the infection on a success. On a failure, the infected creature's body is slowly taken over by fungal growth, and after three such failed saves, la créature dies and is reanimated as a spore servant if it's a type of creature that can be (see the "Myconids" entry in the Monster Manual).
